chameleon.description: Tailor your master CV for a specific job posting. Accepts a job URL or pasted JD text.

tailor-cv.description: Tailor a CV using a previously saved job analysis artifact. Usage: /tailor-cv --analysis <id|path> --cv <name>

score-cv.description: Score a tailored CV against a saved job analysis. Usage: /score-cv --analysis <id|path> --cv <path>

cover-letter.description: Generate a concise cover letter for a role. Usage: /cover-letter <job-url|text> [--resume <name>]

question.description: Answer an application question grounded in your resume. Usage: /question "<question>" [--resume <name>] [--job-url <url>]

init-cv.description: Import a master CV from PDF or YAML. Usage: /init-cv <path-to-file>

render-cv.description: Re-render a CV YAML to PDF. Usage: /render-cv [path-to-yaml]

job-matcher.description: Score jobs against your profile. Usage: /job-matcher score --job-url <url>

bot-start.description: Start the RSS job scanner bridge, Telegram bot, or WhatsApp bot. Usage: /bot-start [bridge|telegram|whatsapp]

bot-status.description: Check which bot services are running. Usage: /bot-status
